reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Sound, and close to the pending human fix
summary: Nemotron diagnosed that the cancel event becomes non-cancelable, and now cancels the Escape keydown whenever keyboard is false, for modal dialogs too, so no close request is sent. Pending pull request #43077 makes the same change.
caveats: The human fix also plays the static-backdrop bounce on each press for modal dialogs and keeps the cancel handler as a fallback for close requests that do not come from a key; the model patch does neither.
Version 5 failed this case three times. The difference in version 6 is the key trace, which shows cancel arriving with cancelable=false.
